items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: There’s a TV on you know, there’s Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Well this has been a fascinating conversation. I’m so glad we had the opportunity. I want to thank you for your time and your — how well you speak about your music and everything that goes with it.

I apologize for going on and on sometimes. You know. But as you can see I probably need to publish my books because as you can see I have a lot to say about it, I’ve got deep feelings about it. It’s been basically a love affair. And I’ll tell you another funny story before we go — I know we’ve got a time element. But you know when my mother first came to me and said she wanted me to take music lessons I was against it. You know? I was about seven, eight, something like that. And I didn’t want to take music…
Terrific. I’ve had a couple — I didn’t know the word but now I do — epiphanies myself like that.
